summary.en: Israeli forces continue to strike terror operatives and suspects who cross the Gaza cease-fire line, extending the ‘Yellow Line’ deeper into Gaza while Palestinian civilians flee attacks and face displacement behind checkpoints. Netanyahu has demanded investigations into the sources of an award-winning Gaza documentary and into Israeli whistleblowers featured in it, reflecting internal scrutiny of the war narrative. Large pro-Palestinian rallies have taken place in London, and Palestinians have voiced frustration over delayed elections, describing their situation as a ghost town. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker fortsetter å slå ned på terroroperatører og mistenkte som krysser våpenhvilelinjen i Gaza, og utvider den «gule linjen» dypere inn i Gaza mens palestinske sivile flykter fra angrep og står overfor fordrivelse bak sjekkpunkter. Netanyahu har krevd etterforskning av kildene til en prisbelønnet Gaza-dokumentar og av israelske varsler som er med i den, noe som viser intern gransking av krigsfortellingen. Store pro-palestinske demonstrasjoner har blitt holdt i London, og palestinere har uttrykt frustrasjon over utsatte valg, og beskriver situasjonen som en spøkelsesby. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
